create_PlasmaArray: create a PlasmaArray wrapper around a numpy array to enable shared memory serialization
start_PlasmaArray_server: start the plasma_store subprocess server for a PlasmaArray instance to prepare shared memory
get_PlasmaArray_client: get the plasma client connection for a PlasmaArray to interact with the shared memory store
pickle_PlasmaArray_getstate: pickle a PlasmaArray object using __getstate__ to serialize the array into shared memory
unpickle_PlasmaArray_setstate: unpickle a PlasmaArray object using __setstate__ to restore the array from shared memory
